subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Ocean Freight
description: A short lesson to help you apply Ocean Freight.

hook.text: 90% of world trade travels by sea. Without ships, globalization as we know it wouldn't exist.

buildup.text: Ocean freight is the cheapest way to move large volumes across continents. Cost per unit is pennies.

discovery.text: Container ships carry up to 24,000 TEUs. Each container is a standardized metal box—easy to stack and move.

twist.text: Transit takes weeks, weather delays are common, and port congestion can stall thousands of containers.

climax.text: The Ever Given blocked the Suez Canal for six days in 2021, holding up $9.6 billion in trade daily.

punchline.text: Slow, cheap, and massive. The ocean carries the world.

quiz.question: What percentage of world trade moves by sea?
